0f42fb9fe966003e.description: Job Description We are seeking an experienced Principal Mechanical Engineer to lead the delivery of complex infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia, with a primary focus on gas systems (LPG, SNG and Natural Gas networks), district cooling/chilled water networks, pump stations, and utility infrastructure . The role will be responsible for providing technical leadership, delivering engineering solutions, securing authority approvals, managing multidisciplinary coordination, and ensuring high-quality project delivery in accordance with local regulations and international standards. The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert, mentor engineering teams, engage directly with clients and authorities, and contribute to the growth and technical excellence of the Infrastructure Business. Responsibilities Lead the design and delivery of mechanical infrastructure projects with a focus on gas systems, district cooling/chilled water networks, and utility pump stations. Provide technical leadership for engineering calculations, specifications, reports, drawings, and procurement support activities. Develop feasibility studies and engineering assessments for cooling strategies, including district cooling and decentralized cooling systems at master planning stage. Evaluate and recommend gas supply solutions, including LPG, Natural Gas (NG), and Synthetic Natural Gas (SNG), based on technical, commercial, and operational requirements. Design gas storage facilities, gas farms, pressure regulating stations (PPRS/SPRS), and associated distribution networks for developments of varying scale. Lead hydraulic modelling and network analysis for gas and chilled water systems using industry-standard software. Prepare and review technical reports, design documentation, engineering specifications, and tender documents. Develop district cooling plant concepts and performance specifications for Design & Build (D&B) projects. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure integrated and efficient infrastructure solutions. Manage authority approvals and liaise with relevant stakeholders, including utility providers, Civil Defense, Ministry of Energy, district cooling operators, and municipal authorities. Review contractor shop drawings, method statements, and material submittals to ensure compliance with project requirements. Ensure all designs comply with applicable local regulations, international standards, safety requirements, and sustainability objectives. Identify project risks and develop mitigation measures to support successful project delivery. Support project planning, resource allocation, budgeting, and programme management activities. Attend and lead technical meetings, client presentations, authority workshops, and design review sessions. Mentor and develop junior engineers, providing technical guidance and supporting professional growth. Maintain high standards of QA/QC throughout project execution and ensure quality deliverables are produced on time and within budget. Act as a trusted advisor to clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring client satisfaction. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized university. Minimum 10–15 years of post-graduate experience in mechanical infrastructure engineering. Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer, or working towards a recognized professional accreditation. Proven experience in the design and delivery of LPG, Natural Gas (NG), and Synthetic Natural Gas (SNG) systems. Strong experience in the design of gas pressure regulating stations (PPRS/SPRS) and gas distribution networks. Extensive knowledge of district cooling systems, chilled water networks, and utility pump stations. Demonstrated experience in utility master planning, feasibility studies, and infrastructure strategy development. Proficiency in hydraulic modelling software such as Bentley WaterGEMS, SISHYD/GasWorks, FLUIDIT, or equivalent. Strong understanding of ASHRAE, SBC, NFPA, IGEM, Civil Defense, Ministry of Energy, and other relevant local and international standards. Experience in preparing technical reports, design calculations, specifications, tender documents, and authority approval submissions. Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams and manage complex infrastructure projects. Experience coordinating with clients, contractors, utilities, and regulatory authorities. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical presentation skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Experience delivering infrastructure projects within Saudi Arabia and/or the GCC region is preferred. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. With us, you can. Apply today.

0f70096b1e44939f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عمق الرؤيا للبصريات عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية وضمان سير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية، بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المدير الإداري مسؤولية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، والإشراف على تنفيذها ومتابعة كافة العمليات الإدارية المتعلقة. كما يضمن توفير الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية. المهام التشغيلية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. التأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لمعرفة مستوى تحقيق الخطط والأهداف الإدارية. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة ومراجعتها باستمرار لتحسينها وضمان جودة وسرعة الخدمات الإدارية. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المختلفة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة وتنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية، وضمان إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بكافة القرارات والتعليمات الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة في الشؤون الإدارية، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتهم بالتحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. يبحث عن مرشح لديه القدرة على الإشراف والتخطيط والتنظيم الفعال للعمليات الإدارية. نوع الوظيفة والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى التقديم لهذا الدور في مؤسسة عمق الرؤيا للبصريات.

0f2a8a8cd3932abb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث أسواق سلة راف التجارية عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى إدارة عمليات الشراء المباشر والمناقصات، بالإضافة إلى متابعة استلام المشتريات وضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة ممتازة للمرشحين الطموحين لبدء مسيرتهم المهنية في مجال المشتريات. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى مندوب المشتريات مسؤولية تنفيذ جميع مراحل عملية الشراء، بدءاً من دراسة الطلبات وحتى استلام المواد وتدقيق المطالبات المالية. يشمل ذلك التعامل مع الموردين، وإدارة المناقصات، وضمان الامتثال للوائح التنظيمية للمشتريات. كما يتضمن الدور إعداد التقارير الدورية لتوثيق سير العمل ونتائج المشتريات. المهام الرئيسية دراسة طلبات الشراء الواردة من الجهات المعنية وتدقيقها لضمان توافقها مع اللوائح التنظيمية للمشتريات. تنفيذ عمليات الشراء المباشر للمواد والسلع وفقاً للوائح والإجراءات المعتمدة. تجهيز وثائق المناقصات وتوزيعها، وجمع عروض التوريد، وتشكيل فرق لدراسة العروض ومتابعتها. تدقيق نتائج دراسة العروض وإرساء طلب الشراء على العرض الأنسب بناءً على اللوائح والتنظيمات المعمول بها. متابعة استلام المشتريات، ومطابقة الكميات والمواصفات مع طلبات الشراء والعروض المقدمة. تدقيق المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بالمشتريات لضمان دقتها وامتثالها للشروط التعاقدية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيق جميع إجراءات وعمليات المشتريات وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المشتريات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق اللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالمشتريات. مهارات جيدة في التفاوض والتواصل مع الموردين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمليات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية، ضمن فريق عمل أسواق سلة راف التجارية. سيعمل المرشح في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام باللوائح والإجراءات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

0f32f7b023cb713f.description: About Mace Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to enhance projects and individuals. The company's values guide its consulting approach and define the professionals it seeks to join its team. The Project and Role This part-time Project Control Manager role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. It involves joining a Mace team to deliver an ultra-luxury residential and hospitality project that includes significant civils and infrastructure scope. The role requires collaboration with architects and global consultants. The Project Control Manager will manage integrated project controls across planning, cost, risk, change, and reporting, supporting safe, timely, and commercially effective delivery from design through construction. Key Responsibilities Manage project programs, budgets, risks, and change controls. Monitor progress against milestones, identifying issues and proposing mitigation actions. Deliver accurate performance reports to support client decision-making. Coordinate with clients, consultants, and project teams to maintain effective governance. Develop team capability and promote continuous improvement initiatives. Champion safety, wellbeing, and sustainability, including carbon reduction efforts. Manage PMO and project controls delivery across assigned commissions. Provide expert guidance on cost, schedule, risk, and change management. Build strong client relationships and drive performance reporting. Align delivery with the Mace control center, mentoring teams and promoting sustainability. Work collaboratively towards the common goal of net zero carbon transition and share responsibility for the proactive identification and management of associated carbon emissions and reductions during work delivery. Required Qualifications and Skills A relevant degree or equivalent qualification, with progress towards recognized chartership and ongoing professional development. Consultancy experience in delivering high-value, complex projects or programs. Strong planning, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Sound knowledge of relevant legislation and a commitment to health, safety, and wellbeing. Ability to meet Saudi Arabia’s visa requirements. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

0f4c440c86ac1571.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مساعد طبيب أسنان للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دعم طبيب الأسنان في مهامه اليومية، بما في ذلك تحضير المواد والأدوات، وضمان جاهزية العيادة والمعدات، وتقديم المساعدة المباشرة أثناء الإجراءات العلاجية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال المرضى وإجلاسهم على كرسي الأسنان، وتوثيق بياناتهم الشخصية في ملفاتهم. تنظيف وتطهير وتعقيم الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في عيادة الأسنان، بالإضافة إلى تفقد وتشغيل كرسي الأسنان. تحضير المواد السنية المطلوبة وخلط الحشوات المؤقتة والدائمة، وخلط المواد العازلة. مساعدة طبيب الأسنان أثناء العمل، ومناولته الأدوات والمواد، وسحب اللعاب. تفقد أدوات ومعدات العمل وتنظيفها، وتخزين مواد الأسنان وفقًا لظروف التخزين المناسبة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مساعدة طبيب الأسنان. القدرة على تحضير المواد السنية وخلط الحشوات. معرفة جيدة بتعقيم الأدوات والمعدات الطبية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض، ويوفر فرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة رعاية صحية ديناميكية. طبيعة العمل تتضمن طبيعة العمل تحضير المواد السنية، ومناولة الأدوات لطبيب الأسنان، وتفقد وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات المستخدمة، بالإضافة إلى تخزينها بشكل صحيح. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة معين للموارد البشرية في هذا الدور، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

0f5feb7149b65cda.description: About the Role Al-Enjaz Company is seeking a skilled Mechanical Technician to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in heavy equipment maintenance, encompassing both workshop and field environments. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the optimal performance and reliability of heavy machinery. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and repair mechanical, hydraulic, transmission, and diesel engine faults on various types of heavy equipment. Perform comprehensive overhaul procedures, including stripping, rebuilding, and testing major components such as engines, gearboxes, hydraulic cylinders, and pumps. Execute scheduled preventive maintenance, including fluid changes, inspections, and replacement of wear parts, strictly adhering to OEM specifications. Handle on-site breakdown repairs efficiently and ensure strict compliance with all workshop Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards. Qualifications and Experience A technical diploma or trade certification in Mechanical or Heavy Equipment is required. A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with heavy machinery, including brands such as CAT, Komatsu, Volvo, and heavy trucks. Demonstrated strong expertise in diesel engines, understanding hydraulic schematics, and proficiency in using mechanical diagnostic tools. Work Environment This role operates in both workshop and field settings, requiring adaptability to various working conditions. The position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time commitment. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

0f7d0eb2b4959fbb.description: About the Role Zegna is seeking a Stock Controller to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves comprehensive oversight of stock management processes within the retail environment. Key Responsibilities Oversee all stock transfers, including movements into the warehouse, from the warehouse to stores, and between stores, ensuring accurate recording and updates to minimize discrepancies. Manage warehouse audits, stock counts, discrepancy identification, and resolution processes. Provide regular updates on deliveries, current stock levels, pending orders, claims for damaged or short merchandise, and the replenishment process. Ensure proper adjustment of defective stock items in accordance with company policies. Prepare the annual stock take calendar in collaboration with the Operations Manager and Store Manager, communicate the plan, and ensure compliance by mobilizing necessary resources and manpower for physical stock takes. Oversee the physical stock take process and monitor adherence to established policies and procedures. Review stock take results with the Local Retail & Wholesale Operations Specialist and Finance Manager, reconciling figures by monitoring stock movements and transfers. Prepare reports based on findings, provide recommendations to the Local Retail & Wholesale Operations Specialist, and implement and monitor stock loss action plans. Oversee the shipment process for goods, coordinating with EZ in Italy and logistics companies to ensure timely delivery to stores. Guide, train, appraise, and motivate staff to support their professional development and potential. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in stock control, warehouse management, or a similar operational role. A strong understanding of inventory management principles and retail operations is essential. Required Skills Proficiency in stock management systems and procedures. Strong analytical skills for discrepancy identification and resolution. Excellent organizational and planning abilities, particularly for stock take coordination. Effective communication skills for coordinating with internal teams and external partners. Leadership capabilities for guiding and motivating team members. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with operational scope covering both Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working within a dynamic retail environment, collaborating with various internal departments and external logistics partners. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

0f9fa0f22069fc37.description: About Courtyard by Marriott Courtyard by Marriott focuses on meeting the needs of travelers globally, having designed its first hotel specifically for business travelers. The Courtyard experience aims to provide guests with the resources to thrive, regardless of their trip's purpose. The company seeks individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and are committed to continuous improvement within a collaborative team environment. Role Overview: Captain Banquet As a Captain Banquet at Courtyard by Marriott in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, you will be responsible for overseeing the readiness and service delivery for banquet functions. This full-time role requires a professional who can ensure operational efficiency, guest satisfaction, and adherence to service standards. The position involves coordinating with kitchen staff, managing banquet setups, and ensuring the overall quality of the guest experience. Key Responsibilities Communicate service needs effectively to chefs and head waiters for all functions. Totalize charges for group activities and present bills to group contacts for payment. Ensure banquet halls, restaurants, and break areas are prepared for service. Arrange adequate centerpieces on each table according to event requirements. Verify the cleanliness and presentation of china, glassware, and silverware before use. Welcome guests and ensure their satisfaction throughout the event. Arrange tables in accordance with event type and service standards. Inform the kitchen of additional meal requests, allergies, dietary regimens, and other special requests. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day. Operational and Safety Compliance Adhere to all chain safety policies and procedures. Report maintenance issues, accident risks, accidents, or injuries promptly. Complete required safety training and obtain necessary certifications. Ensure a clean and professional uniform and appearance. Maintain the confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Support colleagues and foster a respectful team environment. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Guest and Communication Standards Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Communicate using clear, appropriate, and professional language. Answer the phone using appropriate etiquette. Listen and respond appropriately to guest and employee concerns. Perform all other tasks requested by managers consistent with the position. Qualifications and Experience Education: High school diploma or equivalent. Related Work Experience: A minimum of 2 years of related work experience in a similar role. Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience is required.

0fb038ee6f36508d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سقور إنرجي العربية للاستشارات الهندسية عن أخصائي إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في تخطيط وتنسيق ومتابعة مشاريع تقييم موارد الطاقة الشمسية وطاقة الرياح، مع ضمان تسليم التقارير الفنية في المواعيد المحددة والتواصل الفعال مع العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنسيق أنشطة المشاريع وجداولها الزمنية ومخرجاتها لضمان إنجاز الأعمال في المواعيد المحددة. متابعة تقدم برامج رصد وقياس موارد الطاقة الشمسية والرياح والالتزام بمواعيد التقارير الدورية. التواصل مع العملاء وتنظيم اجتماعات المشاريع وإعداد محاضر الاجتماعات ومتابعة تنفيذ التوصيات والإجراءات. التنسيق مع الفرق الهندسية وفرق التشغيل والصيانة لمتابعة المشكلات الفنية والتشغيلية والعمل على حلها. تنظيم وثائق المشاريع وإعداد تقارير التقدم والمحافظة على سجلات المخرجات والتسليمات. متابعة توزيع الموارد وتحديد التأخيرات المحتملة ورفع التقارير إلى مدير المشروع. المساهمة في متابعة مستحقات المشاريع ومراحل الفوترة والالتزامات التعاقدية والأعمال الإدارية المرتبطة بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على المساهمة في تخطيط وتنسيق ومتابعة المشاريع. مهارات تواصل فعالة مع العملاء والفرق الداخلية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في الرياض. سيعمل المرشح ضمن فريق الاستشارات الهندسية في مجال الطاقة المتجددة. المزايا المقدمة يتضمن الدور برنامجاً تدريبياً على رأس العمل ضمن مشروع مع جهة حكومية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. نشجع المرشحين المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

0fbcf6d91d70f5b7.description: About Faena The Red Sea Faena The Red Sea is expanding into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, building a new property that aims to combine art, culture, and community with authentic hospitality. The company focuses on creating transformative experiences through imaginative design and meaningful collaboration. This role ensures the attraction, selection, and onboarding of talent aligned with the brand’s culture and service philosophy. Reporting to the Director of People & Culture, the Recruitment Manager partners with department leaders to build high-performing teams and deliver an engaging candidate experience. This full-time position combines strategic workforce planning with hands-on recruitment delivery, focusing on strong talent pipelines, efficient hiring processes, and consistent employer brand representation. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the annual recruitment strategy in alignment with business needs, pre-opening or operational workforce plans, and Saudization targets. Partner with department heads to understand manpower requirements, budget considerations, and succession planning needs. Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including job postings, sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessments, offers, and onboarding coordination. Ensure job descriptions are accurate, market-aligned, and reflective of brand positioning. Build proactive talent pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill roles. Drive innovative sourcing strategies, including social media, recruitment events, career fairs, and industry networking. Build and maintain relationships with local universities, hospitality institutes, and training programs to attract emerging Saudi talent. Manage relationships with recruitment agencies and external partners, negotiating terms and monitoring performance. Oversee onboarding schedules in collaboration with People Operations and Training teams to ensure seamless integration of new hires. Maintain accurate recruitment records, reporting dashboards, and manpower tracking systems. Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement recruitment strategies. Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle. Strong understanding of local labor laws and hiring practices in Saudi Arabia. Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 0fc27e14408224f2.description: About the Role Botanica is seeking a Specialist - Health and Safety to ensure compliance with occupational health, safety, and environmental policies and guidelines. This full-time role involves advising on measures to minimize hazards and maintain a safe working environment, with a focus on preventive strategies. Role Purpose The primary objective of this position is to establish a workplace that meets legal safety standards and cultivates a culture that prioritizes health, safety, and environment. The H&S Specialist advises and assists in the implementation and monitoring of the H&S strategy and management within the subsidiary, requiring vigilance in identifying violations and proactive thinking. Key Responsibilities Compile and maintain safety programs. Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and standardize H&S practices for consistency. Establish and maintain professional relationships with employees. Conduct workplace inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential health, safety, and environmental hazards, and recommend appropriate control measures. Support the development and review of job safety analyses or risk assessments. Initiate, organize, and perform H&S training for employees, contractors, and visitors. Conduct regular staff meetings and promote a safety culture by encouraging safe work practices and recognizing employees who follow safety guidelines. Correct unsafe acts or conditions through the regular line of authority. Develop and implement emergency response plans and coordinate emergency drills. Stop any unsafe acts or processes that appear dangerous or unhealthy. Record and investigate incidents to determine causes. Prepare reports on occurrences, compile and maintain relevant registers, and provide statistical information to the reporting manager and/or immediate superior. Promote a positive safety culture by fostering employee engagement, recognition, and continuous improvement in HSE performance. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant health and safety role. Demonstrated adherence to Health, Safety, and Environmental laws and regulations. Required Skills Strong attention to detail, especially during emergencies. Proactive thinking and attentiveness to preventive measures. Ability to identify violations and recommend appropriate control measures. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary for this position is not disclosed.

0fcad6dc4d410fb2.description: Chief Executive Officer, Golf Saudi Equipment Leasing Co. Golf Saudi is seeking a Chief Executive Officer for its Equipment Leasing Co. (LeasingCo). This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves providing enterprise-wide strategic, commercial, financial, and operational direction for LeasingCo from its establishment and launch through sustainable growth. The CEO will be responsible for the company’s P&L, business performance, asset value preservation, stakeholder confidence, governance, and people leadership. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to build a scalable leasing operating model that aligns with Golf Saudi’s strategic objectives. This will involve leveraging shared services initially, with a transition to dedicated in-house capabilities as justified. The CEO will lead the company through its foundational stages and ensure its long-term success and value creation. Key Responsibilities Lead the company’s vision, strategy, and business plan, translating shareholder priorities into clear objectives and measurable outcomes. Manage the overall P&L, annual budget, forecasts, capital allocation, cash discipline, and long-term value creation for LeasingCo. Establish the legal entity and scalable operating model, sequencing organizational development from launch to steady state. Oversee core divisions including Finance, Commercial, Operations, and Administration as capabilities transition in-house. Drive initial business with Golf Saudi courses through purchase-and-leaseback solutions, then develop and convert the external-course pipeline. Set commercial direction for pricing, leasing packages, revenue growth, target margins, and customer propositions in partnership with Finance. Secure and manage equity, financing, OEM, distributor, and strategic partner relationships, including joint-venture structuring and governance. Protect fleet utilization, service quality, residual asset value, and lifecycle performance across the leasing portfolio through KPIs and management oversight. Establish the governance framework, delegated authorities, policies, internal controls, risk management, and performance-management cadence. Coordinate with Golf Saudi operating companies and shared-service functions to originate demand and enable effective delivery. Build and lead a high-performing executive team, setting clear accountabilities and fostering a culture of ownership and collaboration. Maintain strong relationships with the Board, GS HoldCo, regulators, investors, financing partners, OEMs, distributors, customers, and other strategic stakeholders, providing transparent reporting. Champion continuous improvement and technology-enabled decision-making using commercial, operational, asset, and financial insights to improve performance and scale the business while ensuring regulatory compliance and business continuity. Qualifications and Experience Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field. A master’s degree or MBA is preferred. Professional Experience: A minimum of 12 years of progressive leadership experience in leasing, asset finance, equipment operations, or a comparable capital-intensive services business. This includes significant executive accountability for strategy, P&L, growth, operations, and large teams. Demonstrated experience establishing or scaling a business unit and managing partners or joint ventures is preferred, with KSA market experience considered an advantage. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a leader capable of establishing and growing a new entity within the Golf Saudi ecosystem.

0fdfe88b9daf0d36.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking a Senior Communications & Engagement Specialist for a full-time position in Thuwal, Makkah. This role is responsible for sharing the research, education, and impact of the PSE Division with local, regional, and international audiences. The specialist will translate complex technical topics into clear, engaging stories, combining a strong STEM background with proven experience in science communications and outreach activities. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement a multi-channel communications strategy aligned with PSE and KAUST objectives. Maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across all divisional platforms and materials. Raise the Division’s profile locally, regionally, and internationally through targeted outreach. Align divisional messaging with KAUST Missions, national priorities, and Vision 2030 goals. Promote faculty and student hiring activities, developing targeted communication campaigns to attract talent. Coordinate with the Global Branding and Communications (GBC) office, peer Divisions, research platforms, and the Education and Advancement (E&A) office. Science Communication and Storytelling Write original content in English for local and international audiences and coordinate Arabic content for in-Kingdom and regional outreach. Translate technical research in Energy, AI, Health, Sustainability, and advanced technologies into accessible stories. Work with faculty, researchers, and students to identify ongoing research stories and news. Build and lead communication activities highlighting student and alumni achievements, academic milestones, and career impact. Adapt scientific messaging to fit the cultural and institutional context of stakeholders in Saudi Arabia and the Middle East. Devise tailored content, including bilingual materials, to showcase and support in-Kingdom partnerships. Oversee internal and external publications, including newsletters, brochures, and annual impact reports. Data Visualization and Digital Engagement Collect and analyze divisional data to support strategic reporting and outreach. Create clear charts, infographics, and visual summaries for datasets covering awards, publications, and research highlights. Utilize research databases such as Scopus and Web of Science to track publication metrics. Integrate statistical data and visual analytics into leadership presentations and public communications. Manage the Division’s LinkedIn and X (Twitter) accounts, including planning and publishing. Create and maintain an editorial calendar with clear timelines and content targets. Produce posts in varied formats, including short videos, visuals, research features, and event highlights. Engage with online audiences and track social media metrics to improve content reach. Act as the Division's primary point of contact for media inquiries, in coordination with GBC. Leadership and Stakeholder Support Prepare presentation slide decks, briefing notes, talking points, and speeches for leadership. Provide practical communications advice to leadership for internal initiatives and external stakeholder visits. Develop promotional and informational materials for conferences, workshops, lectures, exhibitions, and VIP visits. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in science communications and outreach. A strong STEM background is required to effectively translate complex technical topics. The role demands proficiency in crafting accessible science stories, managing digital platforms, and preparing leadership presentations.

0f07d9e68c2b8af9.description: ARX is a global network of specialists in engineering, design, and architecture. Our team offers 360° consulting, project management, and technical services in: airports, bridges, buildings, cableways, digital innovation, environment, equipment, geology, geotechnics, hydropower, metros, nuclear plants, oil & gas, pipelines, ports, railways, river engineering, roads, traffic, tunnels, and water/wastewater treatment. With offices across Europe, North and South America, Asia, Africa, and Oceania, our agile task force combines global expertise with local know-how. The result is our uniquely "glocal" approach, which allows us to meet the specific needs of each community while incorporating international best practices. At ARX, smart minds strive for a sustainable future, transforming communities one innovative project at a time. People are the heart and soul of ARX. We are a home for innovators, visionaries, and experts to develop talents, launch careers, and collaborate with fellow specialists. ARX values individuals. Believing their brilliance and determination will provide solutions to tomorrow's challenges, we welcome professionals who will both benefit from and enrich our team. ARX, marks a significant expansion into the Middle East with its offices in UAE and KSA. This underscores our dedication to innovation and engineering excellence, bolstering our position in the dynamic GCC market. For our office in Riyadh, we are looking for Senior Roads Engineer - 100% (m/f) The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 8 years of experience in infrastructure projects, with at least 3 years of experience working within the KSA. This role requires a deep understanding of roads and highway design, including geometric, traffic, grading, intersections, junctions, and pavement design. 0f564d008d93c7de.description: About the Role TK Elevator is seeking a BIM Modeler specializing in Vertical Transportation (VT) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves developing, coordinating, maintaining, and updating Building Information Modeling (BIM) models for passenger elevators and escalators across the entire project lifecycle, from design to handover. The position requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain 3D BIM models for passenger elevators and escalators using Autodesk Revit, ensuring compliance with project BIM standards, BIM Execution Plan (BEP), and Employer Information Requirements (EIR). Generate detailed shop drawings directly from BIM models, including sections, elevations, layouts, and interface details, ensuring accuracy and consistency with approved designs. Participate in BIM coordination meetings and workshops, coordinating vertical transportation models with architectural, structural, MEP, and other disciplines. Perform clash detection and model coordination using Autodesk Navisworks Manage, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), and BIM 360, identifying and resolving clashes. Coordinate and model all lift and escalator interfaces, including shaft dimensions, pit requirements, headroom, machine room layouts, and structural openings. Maintain BIM model naming conventions, folder structures, and revision control, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650 principles and project standards. Extract quantities and technical information from BIM models, populating and maintaining model parameters and asset information. Conduct quality checks on BIM models and associated drawings, verifying dimensions, clearances, and consistency with design documents. Prepare and submit deliverables such as Revit BIM models, Navisworks coordination files, shop drawings, clash detection reports, and as-built BIM models. Support engineering, design, factory, and installation teams with accurate BIM information and coordinated models. AutoCAD: For 2D drafting and drawing review. Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM Collaborate Pro: For model sharing, coordination, and issue management. Demonstrated ability to produce shop drawings and perform clash detection. Experience coordinating BIM models with various engineering disciplines. 0f0b2cb67e132c2b.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking a Supervisor Passenger Service for the Flynas MED Station in Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing first-line leadership and guidance to employees within the Passenger Services Department, ensuring excellent customer service and operational compliance. The supervisor will control all functions of the Passenger Services team during shifts, focusing on timely flight departures, accurate bag accounting, and achieving high customer satisfaction for both passengers and airlines. Key Responsibilities Perform all Passenger Service agent tasks in addition to supervisory duties. Lead, inspire, and coach the team to meet and exceed departmental goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements. Conduct Pre/Post Flight Editing and monitor attendance of all Passenger Handling staff. Conduct daily staff briefings, assign work, review for accuracy, and provide recommendations to the Passenger Services Manager. Ensure efficient resource utilization through reallocation and reassignment. Monitor gate and transfer desk processes per flight in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Liaise and coordinate with the PRM team for special handling requests (WCHR/UM/DEPU). Monitor and coordinate flight close-out as per SLAs and dispatch paperwork with the flight controller. Manage queues at the departure terminal to ensure seamless operations. Maintain professionalism in all communications (email, radio, telex, telephone). Computer literacy (Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint). A good understanding of regulatory and recommended procedures within the airport environment. Flexibility to work various shifts, including days, evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in a similar role. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. Application Information The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

0f9d3391913d2bb1.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مشرف تنظيف وتدبير للانضمام إلى فريقها في محايل، عسير. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على أنشطة التدبير في المرافق التجارية وتنسيقها وتنفيذها، لضمان الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المرافق بشكل مستمر. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الجدول الزمني لخدمات التنظيف والتدبير. تخطيط وإعداد الجداول الزمنية الخاصة بأعمال الموظفين. الإشراف المباشر على الموظفين أثناء أدائهم لواجباتهم، بما في ذلك مسح الأتربة، كنس الأرضيات، تنظيف دورات المياه، وتغيير الشراشف. الحث على تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي المعتمدة. مراقبة مخزون إمدادات التنظيف والمعدات والإمدادات الأخرى، والحفاظ عليه لضمان توفرها. اتباع وتطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة في جميع الأنشطة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإشراف على التنظيف والتدبير. القدرة على إدارة وتنسيق فرق العمل بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي والصحة والسلامة المهنية. نوع العمل ومكان الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة محايل بمنطقة عسير. يتطلب الدور حضوراً كاملاً في الموقع للإشراف المباشر على العمليات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نحن نبحث عن مرشح ملتزم وذو كفاءة عالية للمساهمة في الحفاظ على معايير النظافة والترتيب في مرافقنا.

Develop Canvas and Model-Driven Power Apps based on business requirements. Design Power BI datasets, dashboards, semantic models, DAX, and Power Query (M). 0f8110914e655a81.description: Basic Function - Safety & Quality Officer The Safety & Quality Officer is responsible for ensuring the effective implementation and continuous monitoring of the Safety Management System (SMS) and Quality Management System (QMS) at Gateway Facilities, in full compliance with GACA regulatory requirements. This includes oversight of safety reporting, risk management, compliance monitoring, audits, and the promotion of a strong safety and quality culture. Key Responsibilities – Safety & Quality Officer General Provide Quality and Safety coverage from the assigned base location at Riyadh Airport. Extend Quality and Safety support to Dammam Airport and designated MODON industrial warehouses in Khamis Mushait, Hail, and Madinah through planned monthly visits (one working day per location). Ensure consistent implementation, monitoring, and follow-up of Safety and Quality requirements across assigned locations. Ensure compliance with GACA regulations, company policies, and applicable aviation safety and quality standards. Support the effective implementation and continuous improvement of the Safety Management System (SMS) and Quality Management System (QMS). Promote a positive safety and quality culture across Gateway Facilities. Planning Participate in safety and quality planning activities, including objectives, programs, and performance indicators. Assist in the development and maintenance of safety and quality manuals, procedures, and work instructions. Support risk assessment and hazard identification activities. Internal Control Conduct internal inspections and compliance monitoring in line with approved inspection plans. Monitor corrective and preventive actions to ensure timely and effective closure. Verify compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. Administration of Safety & Quality Issues Manage safety reports, non-conformities, and quality findings. Coordinate investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes. Maintain safety and quality records and documentation. Reports Prepare and submit safety and quality reports, statistics, and performance summaries to management and relevant authorities as required. Track safety and quality trends and provide recommendations for improvement. Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Support the implementation of EHS policies and procedures. Monitor workplace health, safety, and environmental compliance. Promote awareness of EHS requirements and best practices. Business Continuity Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of business continuity and emergency response plans. Participate in drills, exercises, and post-exercise evaluations. Ensure safety and quality considerations are integrated into continuity planning. Competencies – Professional and Technical Behavioral Competencies Analytical Thinking — Level 2 Communication — Level 3 Creative Thinking — Level 2 Planning & Organizing — Level 2 Teamwork — Level 3 Technical Competencies – Safety & Quality Officer Knowledge of GACA regulations and applicable aviation standards — Advanced Understanding of Safety Management Systems (SMS) principles — Advanced Understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and compliance monitoring — Intermediate Risk assessment and hazard identification techniques — Intermediate Incident reporting and investigation methods — Advanced Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) management — Intermediate Safety and quality data analysis and reporting — Advanced EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) fundamentals — Intermediate Business continuity and emergency response planning awareness — Intermediate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Abide by the goal-setting forms (Individual KPIs) of the current financial year. Demonstrated experience in supporting or implementing SMS and QMS in line with GACA requirements. Language Fluency in English (spoken and written). Note: Industry experience wherever applicable.

0f16e39fee25b6bf.description: About Foodics Foodics is a restaurant management ecosystem and payment technology provider, established in 2014. Headquartered in Riyadh, the company operates offices in five countries, including the UAE, Egypt, Jordan, and Kuwait, serving customers and partners in over 35 countries globally. Foodics has processed over 6 billion orders and has secured three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million. This full-time position involves overseeing daily team operations and ensuring the achievement of retention, churn, and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) targets. The Team Leader will serve as the primary on-site point of contact for the team and will work closely with the Renewals Manager. This role requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Lead, coach, and support a team of Renewal Specialists on a daily basis. Plan daily and weekly activities, including portfolio coverage, call plans, and follow-ups. Conduct daily stand-ups and monthly 1:1 meetings with team members. Ensure adherence to renewal processes, playbooks, and quality standards. Manage team attendance, schedules, and coverage during leaves or absences. Own team targets for renewal rate, churn, and ARR retention. 0fd3da62a0ff0058.description: About the Role Mitsubishi Electric Saudi Ltd. is seeking an experienced Design Engineer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Review and analyze specifications, sketches, drawings, ideas, and related data to assess factors affecting component installations and to determine required procedures and instructions. Verify dimensions of materials to be used and assign identification numbers to materials. Modify and revise designs to correct operating deficiencies or to reduce installation and maintenance problems. Print and file documents and drawings for easy retrieval and access. Maintain an archived database of all completed work. Lay out, draw, and reproduce illustrations for reference manuals and technical publications to describe the operation and maintenance of escalators and elevators. 0f1ed3afe8ee67b5.description: About the Role Al Futtaim Group is seeking an HSSE Manager to lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Health, Safety, Security, and Environment programs for Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD operations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time position ensures compliance with KSA regulatory frameworks and Al-Futtaim Group HSSE governance standards. The role reports to the Head of Government Relations & HSSE and is based across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam, serving the wider KSA dealer network. Role Purpose and Context The HSSE Manager is directly accountable for protecting the workforce, customers, assets, and brand reputation across BYD showrooms, workshops, parts warehouses, and corporate sites. This role is critical for enabling business growth by ensuring uninterrupted operations, securing statutory certifications, and embedding a strong safety-first culture throughout the BYD KSA footprint. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Loss Prevention and Risk Management Responsibilities Drive hazard identification and gap reporting across all assigned BYD KSA sites through scheduled inspections, risk assessments, and field walkthroughs. Reduce preventable incidents through structured corrective and preventive action plans, ensuring all findings are tracked to closure on the Site Compliance & Hazard Tracker. Conduct full-cycle incident investigations for all medium and high-severity events within 24 hours of occurrence and ensure root-cause analysis is documented in the HSSE IMS. Maintain the Automotive Risk Register with up-to-date hazard observations, control measures, and residual risk ratings. Achieve and sustain a minimum 80% compliance score across all HSSE Compliance Audits for assigned sites. Compliance and Regulatory Requirements Ensure full alignment with all KSA HSSE legislation including Saudi Civil Defense regulations, MHRSD Occupational Safety & Health requirements, HCIS standards where applicable, SASO, and Environmental requirements set by the National Centre for Environmental Compliance. Secure and renew all statutory permits including Civil Defense Safety Certificates, Environmental Clearance, and Municipal HSSE clearances for trade license renewal. Stay current with KSA regulatory developments and proactively implement operational adjustments to safeguard the business from violations, financial penalties, and operational disruption. Ensure zero notices of violation across all assigned sites and no pending high-risk audit recommendations beyond 90 days. Represent Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD in regulatory inspections, OEM HSSE audits, and third-party assessments. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of experience in Health, Safety, Security, and Environment management, with a strong understanding of KSA regulatory frameworks. The ability to manage complex compliance requirements and drive continuous improvement in HSSE programs is essential. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply directly.

0f31a6b0ec929bfc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث بيت الخبرة الأولى عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحديد المخاطر المهنية في بيئات العمل المختلفة، ووضع برامج للوقاية من الأمراض المهنية، وضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية، الفيزيائية، الإشعاعية، والبيولوجية. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات للحد من تأثير هذه المخاطر على العاملين، وتحويلهم للفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة، التهوية، والضجيج في مواقع العمل، ومقارنتها بالمستويات المقبولة، والتوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ مختلف أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد وتحليل المخاطر المهنية المختلفة. معرفة جيدة بمعايير ومستويات الصحة والسلامة المهنية المقبولة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في المراقبة والمتابعة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية بدقة. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم التوصيات والإرشادات. الالتزام بتطبيق قواعد السلامة العامة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر الوظيفة في الرياض، وتتطلب العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في بيت الخبرة الأولى. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية.

It operates as the largest B2B live and on-demand events organizer in Saudi Arabia. Tahaluf collaborates with government and non-government organizations in the Saudi B2B and B2C large-scale events sector, organizing events such as LEAP, Cityscape, Black Hat MEA, and CPHI Middle East. The Role of Investor Programme Manager Tahaluf is seeking an Investor Programme Manager to develop and execute the Investor Programme for Cityscape West. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves connecting Family Offices, UHNWIs, and private investors with real estate, hospitality, and development opportunities across Saudi Arabia’s Western Region. The role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on identifying and building relationships with private capital decision-makers, while delivering a curated investor experience. Key Responsibilities Identify, qualify, and recruit Family Offices, UHNWIs, private investment companies, real estate investors, and other private capital sources from KSA, the GCC, and international markets. Build relationships with Family Office Principals, CIOs, CEOs, Investment Directors, and other senior decision-makers. Assess investors based on deployable capital, investment track record, typical ticket size, decision-making authority, and interest in Saudi opportunities. Understand individual investment mandates and facilitate introductions with developers, project owners, hospitality groups, government stakeholders, and potential JV partners. Support private investor roundtables, dinners, site visits, 1:1 meetings, project presentations, and VIP networking experiences. Develop knowledge of investment opportunities across Jeddah, Makkah, Madinah, and the Red Sea, focusing on residential, hospitality, branded residences, mixed-use, and tourism-related developments. Manage the investor journey from initial outreach and onboarding to onsite engagement and post-event follow-up. Collaborate with developers, government entities, sponsors, Family Office networks, private banks, and internal Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams. Maintain an accurate investor pipeline and track recruitment, meetings, introductions, investor interests, and potential investment outcomes. Benefits and Allowances BUPA Medical Insurance for the employee and family. 25 days of annual leave. Remote working on Sundays. Option to work remotely for one month annually. Wellbeing benefits. Family visa costs (for up to three children). Individual annual flight allowance for expatriates. Relocation Packages (If Eligible) International Relocation Package: Paid flight to Riyadh for the employee and family (up to three children). 60 days of accommodation in a serviced apartment or a one-off payment of SAR 5,000 upon arrival. Reimbursement of shipping goods/excess baggage costs up to SAR 2,500. Individual paid flight home and an end-of-service gratuity payment upon leaving the company. Local Relocation Package: Paid flight to Riyadh for the individual and family (up to three children). 30 days of accommodation in a serviced apartment or a one-off payment of SAR 5,000 upon arrival. Reimbursement of shipping goods/excess baggage costs up to SAR 2,500.

0fe30f9dfc193981.description: The Warehouse Chemist is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and efficient management of chemicals and dangerous goods within warehouse operations. The role oversees the receipt, inspection, classification, storage, handling, and disposal of hazardous materials while ensuring compliance with local and international chemical safety regulations. The Warehouse Chemist provides technical expertise to support warehouse operations, minimize risks, maintain regulatory compliance, and promote best practices in chemical management. The position also supports audits, emergency response activities, and continuous improvement initiatives related to hazardous materials management. Key Responsibilities Receive, inspect, identify, classify, and verify chemicals and dangerous goods to ensure compliance with purchase specifications and regulatory requirements. Ensure the safe storage, segregation, handling, and transportation of chemicals in accordance with applicable safety standards and regulations. Conduct routine inspections of chemical storage areas and recommend corrective actions to address safety, environmental, and compliance risks. Monitor chemical inventory, shelf life, storage conditions, and maintain accurate records, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and regulatory documentation. Assess chemical compatibility and perform risk assessments to minimize hazards and support safe warehouse operations. Coordinate the safe disposal of expired, obsolete, or hazardous chemicals in compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements. Provide technical guidance and awareness training to warehouse personnel on chemical safety, hazardous material handling, PPE, and emergency response procedures. Collaborate with Procurement, HSE, Logistics, and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance, support audits, investigate incidents, and continuously improve chemical management practices. Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, Medical Laboratory Science, Chemical Technology, or a related scientific discipline. Minimum of four (4) years of experience in chemical warehouse operations, hazardous materials management, laboratory, or industrial chemical environments. Strong knowledge of chemical properties, hazard classification, compatibility, and hazardous material handling practices. Familiarity with applicable regulations, including GHS, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR), IMDG Code, ADR, and local regulatory requirements. Proficiency in interpreting and applying Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and implementing safe chemical storage and segregation practices. Experience conducting chemical risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Good understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management systems, hazardous waste management, and environmental compliance. Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office and warehouse management systems.
